description: This file defines a React functional component 'TraceView' which is responsible for displaying trace information within a test or trace viewer. It manages loading, polling for live trace data, and rendering within a 'Workbench' component. It also includes utility functions for obtaining output directories and loading trace data from files.

methods.name: outputDirForTestCase
methods.description: Determines the output directory for a given test case by traversing its parent suites and extracting the project's output directory.

methods.name: loadSingleTraceFile
methods.description: Fetches and loads a TraceModel from a specified file path, returning a new TraceModel instance initialized with the trace data.
